source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "infrastructure studies" OR infrastructuring OR "information infrastructure" AND sociotechnical
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"infrastructure studies" OR infrastructuring OR "information infrastructure" AND sociotechnical,is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("infrastructure studies" OR "infrastructuring" OR ("information infrastructure" AND "sociotechnical"))
